heading: `ds/pauseRequested`
text:
### `ds/pauseRequested` [NDBG.15.6]

DAP notification (type: `"event"`, no response expected) sent from
the leader tier to follower tiers in a debug group when a breakpoint
fires, requesting coordinated pause per [NDBG.22.2.1].

```json
{
  "leader_tier_id": "sensor_tier",
  "reason": "breakpoint",
  "breakpoint_description": "Sensor asserted: entity_id=kitchen_temp"
}
```

`reason` matches the `reason` field of the `stopped` event on the
leader tier. Followers finish their current pump cycle then pause.
